run_reference_replay: run reference replay episodes in Habitat environment and compute success rate and SPL metrics
make_videos: create video files from observation frames saved to the demos output directory
save_image: save a single observation frame as a PNG image file to the demos folder
run_cli_replay: run the objectnav replay CLI tool with a dataset path and optional video saving flags
review_run_reference_replay: review the run_reference_replay function to understand how it replays episodes and calculates SPL metrics
